entries.description: Routed Session 1 ai-assignment.md authoring and wrote the result to disk.
Completed required reading for the repo workflow docs plus strategy, HHC-vs-Northwind comparison, the Add-an-Order baseline package, and the workflow-package template.
Verified there was no uncommitted prior-session work in docs/session-sets/workflow-package-pilot/, docs/session-sets/form-report-code-and-grouping/, or tests/AccessHarvester.CharacterizationTests/.
Ran the live harvester pipeline against samples/HomeHealthCare.accdb and produced raw/kb/ir output under tmp/generalization-validation-on-non-northwind/AccessMetaData/HomeHealthCare/.
Authored inventory.md capturing the Add-a-Client forms, helper modules, queries/tables, behavior-bearing procedures, Northwind analogues, and harvester coverage notes.
Authored packages/add-a-client.md in the seven-section template, including the HHC-specific OpenArgs/listbox divergences and the corrected note that tblClients has no data macro.
Added the AddAClient characterization suite covering client defaults/save gating, field validation and normalization, and delete/deactivate lifecycle policy.
Recorded harvester coverage notes inline in inventory.md, including that live extraction succeeded cleanly and that tblClients validation is form-plus-table-rule based rather than data-macro based.

dotnet build succeeded. dotnet test initially failed on a pre-existing missing tmp/comprehension-ir Northwind fixture; regenerated the canonical Northwind fixture into tmp/comprehension-ir via the harvester pipeline, then re-ran dotnet test to a fully green pass.

Cross-provider session-verification routed via query("gemini-pro", task_type="session-verification") because the router override is calibrated for Claude, not this Codex/OpenAI session. Round 1 verdict: VERIFIED. Saved raw output to session-reviews/session-001.md.
Routed Session 2 orchestrator recommendation via gemini-pro; wrote session-1-next-orchestrator-recommendation.md.
